title: The 3 Best 4K Monitors 2026
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for 4k monitors 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.

90W USB-C PD charges most laptops directly
Near-perfect color accuracy out of box
